text: Then Allah showed Ibrahim the place of His House. And father and son began to build.
Ibrahim laid the stones. Ismail carried them. And as the walls of the Kaaba rose, they prayed:
"Our Lord, accept this from us. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing."
Our Lord, make us Muslims to You, and from our descendants a Muslim nation. Show us our rites, and accept our repentance.

And they asked for one more thing: our Lord, send among them a messenger from themselves, who will recite Your verses to them. Thousands of years later, that dua was answered: Prophet Muhammad, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam.
Then Allah commanded: "Proclaim to the people the Hajj. They will come to you on foot, and on every lean camel, from every distant pass."
And they still come. Millions of people every year, answering the call of Ibrahim.
